questions.explanation: The words 'Socialist' and 'Secular' were inserted into the Preamble by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976.

questions.subject: Indian Society
questions.question: Which of the following statements about caste mobility is correct?

options.A: Caste mobility refers to changes in the social, economic or political position of individuals or groups associated with caste
options.B: Caste mobility refers to the physical movement of caste groups from one region to another
options.C: Caste mobility refers to the abolition of the caste system
options.D: Caste mobility refers to the practice of endogamy

questions.explanation: Caste mobility refers to changes in the social, economic or political position of individuals or groups associated with caste. Education, occupation, migration, political participation and social movements can influence such changes.

questions.subject: Indian Society
questions.question: Which of the following statements about tribal customary law is correct?

options.A: It refers to community-recognised norms and practices governing social relations, inheritance, land use and dispute settlement, whose legal recognition and application vary and remain subject to the Constitution and applicable laws
options.B: It is statutory law enacted by Parliament
options.C: It is international law
options.D: It is completely unrelated to the Constitution

questions.explanation: Tribal customary law refers to community-recognised norms and practices governing matters such as social relations, inheritance, land use and dispute settlement. Its legal recognition and application vary and remain subject to the Constitution and applicable laws.

questions.subject: Indian Society
questions.question: Which of the following statements about class mobility is correct?

options.A: Class mobility refers to movement from one socioeconomic position to another, which may be upward or downward and can occur across generations or within an individual's lifetime
options.B: Class mobility refers to the physical movement of people from one region to another
options.C: Class mobility refers to the abolition of class distinctions
options.D: Class mobility refers to the inheritance of caste status

questions.explanation: Class mobility is movement from one socioeconomic position to another. It may be upward or downward and can occur across generations or within an individual's lifetime.

questions.subject: Indian Society
questions.question: Which of the following statements about national integration is correct?

options.A: It is the process of strengthening a shared national identity, mutual respect, solidarity and participation among people belonging to different social, cultural and regional groups
options.B: It is the process of making all citizens identical in culture
options.C: It is the abolition of regional identities
options.D: It is the merger of all states into one administrative unit

questions.explanation: National integration is the process of strengthening a shared national identity, mutual respect, solidarity and participation among people belonging to different social, cultural and regional groups.

questions.subject: Indian Society
questions.question: Which of the following statements about the overall structure of Indian society is correct?

options.A: Indian society is plural and internally diverse, but its communities are connected through shared institutions and constitutional citizenship; its social structure includes both traditional identities and changing economic, political and cultural relationships
options.B: Indian society is completely uniform and homogeneous
options.C: Indian society is defined only by caste
options.D: Indian society has no traditional identities

questions.explanation: Indian society is plural and internally diverse, but its communities are connected through shared institutions and constitutional citizenship. Its social structure includes both traditional identities and changing economic, political and cultural relationships.
